subject: Cordata: exec exception request — liability cap & pricing ask
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cordata.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalia Ruiz <natalia.ruiz@cordata.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial redlines + purchase ask (Cordata pilot)

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited. Attached are Cordata's initial redlines. Two items we need to resolve to proceed with the pilot this quarter:

1) Liability cap: we redlined to a mutual cap equal to fees paid in the 12 months following termination (Cordata prefers this floor).
2) Indemnity: Cordata requests broader customer indemnity carve-outs for third-party IP claims and requests removing the "gross negligence" qualifier on our side.
3) Commercial: procurement is asking for a 30% pilot discount off list for the first 6 months and a 60-day payment term to align with vendor policy.

Please confirm whether Redwood can accept these or what concessions you can offer. We can run internal approvals quickly if we get a counter.

Attachments: Cordata_Redlines_0620.pdf

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Procurement Manager, Cordata Health
procurement@cordata.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cordata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines + purchase ask (Cordata pilot)

Tom — appreciate the clear summary and the redlines. We're aligned to move fast on pilots, so I wanted to loop in internal partners. High level:

- Liability cap: we can consider a fixed cap for the pilot (we're thinking $500k for year 1) rather than fees-paid, but need exec sign-off for an exception.
- Indemnity: Redwood's legal is open to reciprocal indemnities and clarifying IP carve-outs, but removing the gross negligence qualifier is a material change we normally don't accept.
- Pricing: 30% off list is deeper than our standard pilot discount band; can likely do 20–25% with a committed purchase order and 12-month renewal language. 60-day payment terms are also out of policy; we can accept net 30 for pilot customers unless covered by a committed spend.

I'm copying Marissa (contracts) and Vivek (sales leader) to request an executive exception decision. If you can confirm Cordata will commit to a minimum $75k pilot spend + SOC2 within 30 days, that materially helps the ask.

Thanks — I'll send an internal summary for quick review.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: FWD: Cordata — exec exception required (liability + discount)

Folks — forwarding Cordata's redlines and the thread with a concise ask. Please review; need an exec-level decision so we can issue a counter. Summary below: 

What Cordata asks:
- Liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months (customer-favored)
- Remove gross negligence qualifier on Redwood indemnity
- 30% pilot discount + net60 payment terms

Our proposed counter (requires sign-off):
- Liability cap: fixed $500,000 (applies for 12 months)
- Indemnity: mutual indemnity, Redwood will not accept removal of gross negligence carve-out; carve-outs for third-party IP infringement are negotiable with standard notice/cooperation clauses
- Pricing: 25% pilot discount if Cordata commits to $75k pilot spend + 12-month renewal at standard pricing; payment term: net30

Risks: increasing liability cap beyond policy increases exposure; removing gross negligence qualifier materially raises legal risk. Approving the counter is a commercial decision — we can mitigate with committed spend and SOC2 evidence.

Ask: Approve the proposed counter (liability cap $500k, 25% pilot discount + commit) or suggest alternate language. Need decision EOD Tue 22 Jun to keep Cordata on schedule.

— Steph
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Cordata — exec exception required (liability + discount)

I support a limited exception with the following clarifications:

1) Liability cap: Approve $500k for year 1 but change wording to "lesser of $500,000 or fees paid in the prior 12 months" so we have a ceiling but also align to fees if they become material.
2) Indemnity: Must remain reciprocal; we cannot accept removing gross negligence. For IP claims, require notice/cooperation and limit to direct damages.
3) Pricing & terms: Approve 25% pilot discount conditional on a signed PO for $75k and SOC2 evidence provided within 30 days. Payment term: net45 if procurement insists, but require a purchase order up front.

If legal is comfortable with the "lesser of" language, let's send the counter. Marissa — can you confirm on legal language and whether we need a board/CEO notification for the exception?

— Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cordata.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Natalia Ruiz <natalia.ruiz@cordata.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cordata: exec exception request — liability cap & pricing ask

Tom / Natalia — thanks for your patience. Redwood can move forward with a limited exception. Summary of approved counter (attached redline):

- Liability cap: the cap will be the lesser of $500,000 or fees paid in the prior 12 months. Applies for the pilot term and first 12 months after signature.
- Indemnity: mutual indemnity remains; Redwood cannot remove the gross negligence qualifier. IP indemnity will follow standard notice/cooperation and be limited to direct damages.
- Pricing: 25% discount for the first 6 months of the pilot, conditional on a signed PO for at least $75k and provision of SOC2 summary within 30 days.
- Payment terms: Net45 with PO up front; we can discuss net60 only if procurement provides a formal payment plan and references.

Attached is RDW_Final_Counter_0625.pdf with the redlines and a DocuSign link to the counter. If you confirm acceptance, we'll route to Legal for signature and finalize.

Attachments: RDW_Final_Counter_0625.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Next steps: please sign via DocuSign (link below) or indicate any narrow language tweaks.
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/cordata-rdw-counter-0625

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
